what: Cisco makes the networking equipment that runs company networks and the internet (switches, routers, Wi-Fi), plus security and observability software, including Splunk.
customers: Businesses, governments, telecom operators and cloud companies.
money: switches, routers, wireless and data-center networking for AI
moat: A huge installed base, strong relationships with IT departments and growing recurring software revenue.
risks: Competition in data-center networking for AI
opportunities: Revenue grew about 12% last year as networking demand recovered
Analysts see about 34% upside from current levels
AI data centre orders have become a meaningful and growing revenue line
watch: AI infrastructure orders and software subscription revenue.
